profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Nvidia
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineering lead and systems strategist with a passion for building scalable, intelligent solutions that bridge infrastructure, AI, and user-centered design. Currently contracting with NVIDIA, I lead cross-functional projects that blend enterprise software development, cloud-native architecture, and AI-enhanced automation.

With deep experience in .NET development, Python, and modern database systems, I specialize in modernizing legacy platforms through API-driven microservices, secure infrastructure, and seamless integration of AI workflows. I design and implement intelligent backend systems — including RAG-based APIs, vector search, and natural language interfaces — to help teams work smarter and faster.

My work spans CI/CD automation, containerization, secret management, and secure deployments across both cloud and on-prem environments. From implementing NLP-powered Jira bots to building high-performance internal tools, I focus on clean architecture, operational efficiency, and developer experience.
